transcript.content:
<issue>
Async trigger behaviours are not included when calling GetInfo
Async trigger behaviours are not included when calling GetInfo, resulting in incomplete graphs.
In the following snippet, `stateMachineInfo` will not contain the transition from A to B.

``` csharp
var sm = new StateMachine<State, Trigger>(State.A);
sm.Configure(State.A)
    .PermitIfAsync(Trigger.X, State.B, () => Task.FromResult(true));

var stateMachineInfo = sm.GetInfo();
```

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed (Stateless C# lib), find where StateMachineInfo / StateInfo.CreateStateInfo / StateRepresentation builds transitions info from TriggerBehaviours (e.g. GetInfo, FixedTransitions, DynamicTransitions). Report the code of StateInfo.cs and StateRepresentation's TriggerBehaviours field declaration and any other places that filter by `TriggerBehaviour` vs `TriggerBehaviourAsync`/ `TriggerBehaviourResult`. Also show how async trigger behaviours are stored (class names, files).

content.content: {"summary":"StateInfo.cs builds reflection info only from the sync `StateRepresentation.TriggerBehaviours` dictionary. Async behaviours live in a separate dictionary (`TriggerBehavioursAsync`), and StateInfo never reads it. The only async type StateInfo checks is `DynamicTriggerBehaviourAsync`, which actually derives from the sync `TriggerBehaviour`, so it sits in the sync dictionary.","findings":["StateRepresentation.cs:14: `internal IDictionary<TTrigger, ICollection<TriggerBehaviour>> TriggerBehaviours { get; } = new Dictionary<...>()`. AddTriggerBehaviour is at StateRepresentation.cs:256.","StateRepresentation.Async.cs:12: `internal IDictionary<TTrigger, ICollection<TriggerBehaviourAsync>> TriggerBehavioursAsync { get; }`. AddTriggerBehaviourAsync is at :135.","src/Stateless/Reflection/StateInfo.cs, CreateStateInfo: loops over `stateRepresentation.TriggerBehaviours` and keeps items that are `IgnoredTriggerBehaviour`, via IgnoredTransitionInfo.Create. It also takes the entry, activate, deactivate and exit actions.","StateInfo.cs, AddRelationships (about lines 47-82): loops over `TriggerBehaviours` only and filters with `Where(b => b is X)`. `TransitioningTriggerBehaviour` and `ReentryTriggerBehaviour` become FixedTransitions via `.Destination`. `InternalTriggerBehaviour` becomes a FixedTransition whose destination is the state itself. `DynamicTriggerBehaviour` and `DynamicTriggerBehaviourAsync` add `.TransitionInfo` to DynamicTransitions.","StateInfo.cs never reads `TriggerBehavioursAsync`. It also never matches `TransitioningTriggerBehaviourAsync` or `ReentryTriggerBehaviourAsync`, so those are missing from FixedTransitions. Ignored triggers are not affected, because IgnoredTriggerBehaviour is sync only.","`StateInfo.AddRelationships` assigns Superstate, Substates, FixedTransitions and DynamicTransitions. The `Transitions` property concatenates Fixed and Dynamic.","Class hierarchy: TriggerBehaviour.cs:8 `abstract TriggerBehaviour : TriggerBehaviourBase`, with TriggerBehaviourBase at :52. TriggerBehaviour.async.cs:9 `abstract TriggerBehaviourAsync : TriggerBehaviourBase` (guard is TransitionGuardAsync).","Sync subclasses of TriggerBehaviour: TransitioningTriggerBehaviour.cs, ReentryTriggerBehaviour.cs, IgnoredTriggerBehaviour.cs, DynamicTriggerBehaviour.cs, and InternalTriggerBehaviour.Sync (InternalTriggerBehaviour.cs:17). InternalTriggerBehaviour.Async at :38 also derives from InternalTriggerBehaviour, which derives from the sync TriggerBehaviour, so it sits in the sync dictionary too.","Subclasses of TriggerBehaviourAsync: TransitioningTriggerBehaviourAsync (TransitioningTriggerBehaviour.async.cs:5) and ReentryTriggerBehaviourAsync (ReentryTriggerBehaviour.async.cs:5). `DynamicTriggerBehaviourAsync` (DynamicTriggerBehaviour.Async.cs:8) derives from the sync TriggerBehaviour, not TriggerBehaviourAsync.","TriggerBehaviourResult.cs: has two constructors, one taking TriggerBehaviour (sets `Handler`) and one taking TriggerBehaviourAsync (sets `HandlerAsync`). It also exposes UnmetGuardConditions.","StateRepresentation.cs:48-100: TryFindHandler, TryFindLocalHandler (:61), TryFindLocalHandlerResult (:85) and TryFindLocalHandlerResultWithUnmetGuardConditions (:98) use only the sync dictionary.","StateRepresentation.cs:233-245: internal-transition handling checks `result.Handler is InternalTriggerBehaviour.Async` and casts `result.Handler as InternalTriggerBehaviour.Sync`.","StateRepresentation.Async.cs:149 iterates `TriggerBehavioursAsync`. Line 168 reads `TriggerBehaviours`. TryFindHandlerAsync is at :187. TryFindLocalHandlerAsync (:204-231) looks up both dictionaries and builds TriggerBehaviourResult for each."],"confidence":0.85}

content.content: {"summary":"In both async behaviour classes, `Destination` is `internal`, not public. Both classes are also `internal`, nested in the partial class `StateMachine<TState,TTrigger>`. The non-async `.cs` files also declare `Destination` as `internal`, at the line numbers below.","findings":["src/Stateless/TransitioningTriggerBehaviour.async.cs:7 — `internal TState Destination { get; }` is an auto-property with no setter. The constructor sets it at line 13. The class `TransitioningTriggerBehaviourAsync` (line 5) is internal and derives from `TriggerBehaviourAsync`.","src/Stateless/ReentryTriggerBehaviour.async.cs:9 — `internal TState Destination { get { return _destination; } }` is backed by the readonly field `_destination` (line 7). The class `ReentryTriggerBehaviourAsync` (line 5) is internal and derives from `TriggerBehaviourAsync`.","The constructors in both files are declared `public`, but they sit inside internal classes, so they are effectively internal.","The non-async files, src/Stateless/TransitioningTriggerBehaviour.cs:7 and src/Stateless/ReentryTriggerBehaviour.cs:9, also declare `Destination` as `internal`."],"confidence":0.97}
